projects.name: Billboard Longevity Prediction
projects.title: Billboard Longevity Prediction
projects.subtitle: Reproducible machine learning
projects.summary: A reproducible workflow for predicting album chart longevity.

notes.title: The analysis
notes.text: Cross-validated k-nearest-neighbors regression using albums in Rolling Stone’s Top 500 dataset.

notes.title: The work around the model
notes.text: GNU Make connects download, cleaning, validation, training, and Quarto reporting. Docker provides a shared computational environment.

projects.attribution: Built with Ritisha Jhamb and Roy Chen. January–April 2025.
overview: Modeled Billboard chart longevity using Rolling Stone’s Top 500 albums. Cross-validated k-nearest-neighbors regression.
Connected data preparation, validation, training, and Quarto reports with GNU Make. Used Docker for a shared computational environment.

projects.name: Airbnb Revenue Prediction
projects.title: Airbnb Revenue Prediction
projects.subtitle: Feature engineering & model comparison
projects.summary: Predicting rental revenue through feature engineering and model comparison.

notes.title: Prepare, then compare
notes.text: Imputed missing values, encoded categorical features, and compared XGBoost, Ridge, and Lasso regression.

notes.title: Choose with validation
notes.text: Used cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning to select a Lasso model, comparing predictions through mean absolute error.

overview: Imputed missing values and encoded categorical features. Compared XGBoost, Ridge, and Lasso regression.
Tuned models with cross-validation. Selected Lasso using mean absolute error.

projects.name: Telehealth Access Disparities
projects.title: Telehealth Access Disparities
projects.subtitle: SQL & statistical inference
projects.summary: Exploring demographic and geographic patterns in telehealth adoption.

notes.title: Make the data queryable
notes.text: Cleaned public telehealth data, organized it into relational tables, and assembled analysis datasets with multi-table SQL joins.

notes.title: Ask a statistical question
notes.text: Used hypothesis tests to examine differences in adoption patterns. Observed associations are not evidence of causality.

overview: Cleaned public telehealth data into relational tables. Joined them in SQL to assemble analysis datasets.
Used hypothesis tests to examine adoption differences. Interpreted associations without claiming causality.
